significance: One of the 108 Divya Desams, near Nagapattinam, where Vishnu presides as Loganatha behind a five-tier rajagopuram; later patronage came from Vijayanagara and Madurai Nayak rulers.
story: Krishna is said to have snatched sage Vasishtha's butter offering as a child and, chased to this spot, granted the assembled sages leave to dwell here forever.
